title: Your First Weekend at DePaul University, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Pick Up Your Blue Demon ID
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Park Campus Hub
cards.notes: Visit the ID Services office early to secure your campus card, which grants access to residence halls, the library, and your meal plan funds.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for student services, dining, and ID card issuance on the Lincoln Park campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lincoln Park Student Center houses ID Services and serves as a primary check-in point for new student activities.
cards.source_title: LPC Building Hours | Student Centers | DePaul University, Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM; closed weekends.

cards.title: First Meal at the Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: All-You-Care-To-Eat Dining
cards.notes: Head to the second floor for a variety of food stations. Your meal plan typically activates on move-in day for residential students.
cards.short_summary: The primary residential dining facility offering diverse meal stations and a stress-less zone for allergies.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Demon Dining Hall is located on the 2nd floor of the Student Center and offers all-you-care-to-eat service.
cards.source_title: Blue Demon Dining Hall - DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Weekend hours are typically 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM.

cards.title: Relax on the Lincoln Park Quad
cards.subtitle: The Heart of Campus
cards.notes: Find a spot on the grass to meet new friends or attend the Welcome Back Picnic held here during the first week of the term.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor green space on the Lincoln Park campus used for student gatherings and major university events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quad is described as the heart of the Lincoln Park campus and hosts the annual Welcome Back Picnic.

cards.title: Find Your Weekend Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Park Research Hub
cards.notes: Explore the first-floor 'Unwind the Mind' collection or find a quiet carrel on the upper floors to prepare for your first Monday classes.
cards.short_summary: The main library for the Lincoln Park campus, featuring extensive collections and diverse study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: The John T. Richardson Library offers weekend hours, typically 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM on Saturdays and Sundays.

cards.title: Active Afternoon at 'The Ray'
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use your student ID to access four floors of fitness equipment, basketball courts, and an indoor track to stay active.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art fitness facility providing recreation and wellness programs for the DePaul community.
cards.evidence_claim: DePaul students have access to the Ray Meyer Fitness & Recreation Center as part of their comprehensive fee.
cards.source_title: Facility Hours - Campus Recreation | DePaul University

cards.title: Attend Sunday Night Mass
cards.subtitle: Community Worship
cards.notes: Join the 5:00 PM Sunday Night Mass, a popular tradition where the DePaul community gathers for worship and reflection.
cards.short_summary: A historic Roman Catholic parish adjacent to campus that serves as a spiritual center for many students.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunday Night Mass at 5:00 PM is a designated time for the DePaul community to gather at St. Vincent de Paul Church.
cards.source_title: Liturgy and Prayer | Catholic Campus Ministry | DePaul University

cards.title: Explore the Loop Campus
cards.subtitle: Downtown Academic Hub
cards.notes: Take the Brown Line south to visit the Loop campus. Check out the 11th-floor student lounge for views of the Chicago skyline.
cards.short_summary: The primary building for DePaul's downtown campus, housing the Driehaus College of Business and student services.
cards.evidence_claim: The DePaul Center is the main hub for the Loop campus and includes student lounge spaces on the upper floors.
cards.source_title: Loop Building Hours - Student Centers | DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Building typically closed on Sundays; Saturday hours vary by event.

cards.title: Blue Demon Welcome Convocation
cards.subtitle: New Student Induction
cards.notes: Attend the official New Student Convocation to hear from university leadership and officially join the Blue Demon family.
cards.short_summary: An indoor arena used for athletic events and major university ceremonies like New Student Convocation.
cards.evidence_claim: Blue Demon Welcome, the annual New Student Convocation, begins in the McGrath-Phillips Arena.
cards.source_title: Blue Demon Welcome | Events | DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Access restricted to scheduled events and athletic games.

cards.title: Walk the New Student Cavalcade
cards.subtitle: A DePaul Tradition
cards.notes: Process from the arena to the Quad following Convocation, cheered on by faculty and returning students in this welcome parade.
cards.short_summary: A ceremonial walk for new students marking their official entry into the DePaul University community.
cards.evidence_claim: Following the academic welcome, students process in the New Student Cavalcade from McGrath-Phillips Arena to the Quad.
cards.source_title: Blue Demon Welcome celebrates new and transfer students | DePaul News
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually during the Blue Demon Welcome event.

cards.title: Gear Up at the Bookstore
cards.subtitle: Official Campus Shop
cards.notes: Pick up your textbooks and grab some Blue Demon apparel to wear for 'Blue Thursday' during your first week of classes.
cards.short_summary: The official university bookstore providing course materials, school supplies, and licensed DePaul merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lincoln Park Bookstore is the primary location for purchasing books for classes held on the Lincoln Park campus.
cards.access_notes: Typically closed on Saturdays and Sundays; check for special Welcome Week hours.
